title: Text hyperlinks (URL + Target) — model, UI, FLA import, SWF HTML anchor
description: Flash 8 text Properties-panel parity. The bottom-row Link URL field and 'Target:' dropdown attach an HTML hyperlink to a text field. Fully ABSENT today. Add: (1) linkUrl and linkTarget string fields on TextDisplayObject. (2) UI: URL input plus Target dropdown (_self/_blank/_parent/_top) in PropertiesPanel TextView. (3) FLA import if present in the binary text record. (4) SWF compile: wrap the text in an HTML anchor (a href, target) and set the HTML flag (bit 9) on DefineEditText so Ruffle renders a clickable link (getURL on click). Acceptance: a field with a link publishes as HTML-anchored text that navigates in Ruffle.
